    void work() {
        int n=in.nextInt();
        long[][] dp=new long[2][2*n+1];
        long ret=0;
        dp[0][0]=1;
        for(int p=1;p<=2*n;p++) {
            int cur=p%2;
            int prev=p%2==0?1:0;

                dp[cur][i+1]=(dp[cur][i+1]+dp[prev][i])%mod;

                        ret=(ret+dp[prev][i])%mod;

            }
        }
        out.println(ret);
    }
}
